newsitem.title: UK: Bank of Scotland up on Goldman buy note.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Scotland up on Goldman buy note.

text.p: Shares in the Bank of Scotland climbed to a record high as brokerage Goldman Sachs put a buy note out on the stock, dealers said.
By 1017 GMT, the shares were up 12p to 341-1/2, 1/2p off their best level, in a firm bank sector.
Shares in Royal Bank of Scotland Plc advanced 13p to 601-1/2, while shares in Standard Chartered Plc jumped 13-1/2p to an all-time high of 769.
Shares in Abbey National Plc firmed 7-1/2p to 791-1/2 and National Westminster Bank Plc rallied 9-1/2p to 792, having reached a record at 794.
Barclays Plc shares added 3-1/2p to 114-1/2, while HSBC Holdings rose 25p to 1476-1/2, having climbed to a record 1480.
Goldman bank analyst David Townshend was not immediately available to comment on his recommendation.
